decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tightly linked to the core trailer business, it is cheap to carry and supports the broader product offering, so management would keep it unless sales are clearly negligible.
This box trailer series sits squarely in the firm's main market and capabilities, and after several years it is likely part of the established range rather than an option that needs to be cut.

By 2022 the value of this more specialized car transporter line should be sufficiently revealed, and for a medium-sized firm its narrower market and higher complexity make resource reallocation to stronger core products and new development more attractive.
The low-bed trailer series is close to the firm's core competence and customer base, so management would usually continue it unless there were clear evidence of persistent weak demand.
